description: Malformed protobuf frame: delta_text contains incomplete UTF-8 bytes (eab080eb = 가 + 1 byte of 나) split mid-codepoint. Protobuf string fields require valid UTF-8. A conformant decoder must reject this frame as a fatal UTF-8 error rather than attempting concatenation across invalid strings.

provenance.note: Negative fixture preserving previously split UTF-8 bytes to verify mandatory rejection of invalid UTF-8 in protobuf strings.
